description: Social Security's 2027 cost-of-living adjustment (COLA) is projected at 3.5%, tying for the sixth-largest raise in 35 years. Three factors are driving this increase: President Trump's tariff and trade policies, the ongoing Iran war causing energy price spikes, and the AI infrastructure build-out creating supply shortages and higher consumer prices.
